# netbox_contact_role (Data Source)

Retrieves a single contact role from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_contact_role" "example" {
  name = "Technical"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the contact role. At least one of `name` or `slug` must be given.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the contact role. At least one of `name` or `slug` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
